in_marathi.name: Parmeshwar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Parmeshwar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Parmeshwar is a compound word in Sanskrit. ‘Parm’ means supreme, ultimate, and ‘Eshwar’ is another name for Lord Shiva, the God of creation, destruction, and regeneration. Therefore, Parmeshwar means the supreme lord of the universe.
